title: Unary languages have polynomial layered size
statement: For every set $S$ of natural numbers, the language of all-true Boolean strings whose length belongs to $S$ is computable by a family of finite layered circuits using only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates, with size bounded by $a(n+1)^k$ for some natural numbers $a$ and $k$ at every input length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is an arbitrary set of natural numbers
